overall_summary: Bitcoin is showing renewed strength after rebounding above 63,000 with fresh ETF inflows. Geopolitical risks remain but have not overridden the positive crypto catalysts so far.
key_points: ETF inflows snap multi-day outflow streak
NATO summit looms as key watch event

items.title: Bitcoin Rebounds Above $63,000 on July 4 Trading
items.summary: Bitcoin climbed above 63 thousand dollars for the first time in two weeks during thin holiday trading on July 4, reversing some of the sharp losses that closed out June. The move came amid a modest rebound across crypto markets, with XRP leading gains among major tokens. Traders should watch whether this bounce holds or fades once volume returns, as it signals improving short-term sentiment after heavy selling pressure.
items.impact: Could support further upside if volume confirms the level

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Multi-Day Outflow Streak with Inflows
items.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded net inflows of around 222 million dollars on July 2, ending a streak of outflows that had totaled billions earlier in the period. This shift follows sustained redemptions through much of June and early July. Positive flows can ease selling pressure and support prices, though sustained buying will be needed to shift broader sentiment.
items.impact: Reduces immediate downside risk from ETF redemptions

items.title: Russia Strikes Kyiv, Killing 30 in Major Attack
items.summary: Russian forces launched a large-scale missile and drone assault on Ukraine's capital overnight, hitting residential buildings and killing at least 30 people with dozens more injured. Ukraine says the strikes were retaliation for its recent hits on Russian oil refineries. Traders should watch this as fresh escalation in the Russia-Ukraine war raises risk-off sentiment and potential energy supply concerns.
items.impact: Heightens geopolitical risk premium, pressuring risk assets including crypto.

items.title: Iran Begins Mass Funeral for Slain Leader Khamenei
items.summary: Iran launched days-long state funeral ceremonies for Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, killed earlier in the 2026 US-Israel conflict, with massive crowds expected in Tehran and beyond. Pakistani officials attended, signaling regional diplomatic alignments. This political moment could influence ongoing ceasefire talks and Middle East stability that affects global energy flows.
items.impact: Keeps focus on Iran-related tensions and potential oil market volatility.

items.title: Ukraine Hits Major Russian Oil Terminal in St. Petersburg
items.summary: Ukrainian forces struck a key oil terminal in Russia's St. Petersburg, which President Zelensky called revenue-generating infrastructure for Moscow's war effort. This follows Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian refineries and comes amid Russia's retaliation on Kyiv. Energy infrastructure targeting raises risks of supply disruptions and price swings.
items.impact: Adds to oil market uncertainty, supporting higher energy prices and risk-off flows.

items.title: Trump and Putin Hold 90-Minute July 4 Call
items.summary: US President Trump and Russian President Putin held a businesslike 90-minute phone call on Independence Day, according to Moscow. Details on topics remain limited but occur against the backdrop of the Ukraine conflict and recent Iranian developments. Any de-escalation signals could ease some market tensions.
items.impact: Diplomacy between major powers keeps outcomes fluid for risk assets.

items.title: US Marks 250th Independence Day With Trump Speech
items.summary: America celebrated its 250th anniversary with fireworks, flyovers, and a speech by President Trump in Washington amid a heat wave. Trump referenced past military actions including against Iran. The event underscores ongoing US foreign policy posture relevant to global markets.
items.impact: Limited immediate market catalyst but reinforces themes of US engagement abroad.

items.title: NATO Summit in Ankara Looms This Week
items.summary: NATO leaders prepare for their July 7-8 summit in Ankara, Turkey, to discuss burden-sharing, Ukraine, and alliance strategy. Hosting in Turkey highlights internal alliance dynamics amid broader geopolitical shifts. Outcomes could influence European security and related risk sentiment.
items.impact: Upcoming event leaves markets awaiting clarity on policy directions.
